setup.title: Your service catalogue
setup.description: Add the services you sell, with their price and duration.

ui.title: Services

statusReason.unconfigured: No tax category: it cannot be charged

ui.taxCategoriesMissing: There are no tax categories yet. Set them up in Taxes before adding services.
ui.errorTaxRequired: Pick a tax category: without one the service cannot be charged
ui.archiveHint: it will no longer be offered or bookable. Its history and the appointments already booked are kept.
ui.archiveWarnAppointments: {count} upcoming appointment(s) still use this service. They keep their booking, price and duration; only new bookings stop.
ui.deleteCategoryHint: the category disappears; the services in it are kept, without a category.
ui.deleteCategoryImpact: {count} service(s) will be left without a category.
ui.fixedPriceHelp: Leave empty to price it as the sum of its lines minus the discount.
ui.validityHelp: Days redeemable from the PURCHASE; empty = never expires.
ui.maxUsesHelp: Uses the voucher grants; empty = unlimited.
ui.packageLinesFixed: The services included cannot be changed once created: archive this package and create a new one.
ui.deletePackageHint: the package and its {count} line(s) disappear from the catalogue; vouchers already sold keep their balance.
ui.errorPackageNoLines: Add at least one service: a package with no lines cannot be redeemed.

tender.title: Pay this line with a voucher
tender.none: This customer has no voucher that covers this service.
tender.loadFailed: The customer's vouchers could not be loaded. Try again before charging full price.
tender.holdFailed: That voucher session could not be reserved.
tender.releaseFailed: That voucher session could not be given back.

reason.only_option: The only voucher that covers this service.
reason.finite_before_unlimited: Used first because it has a limited number of sessions.
reason.expires_first: Used first because it expires soonest.
reason.already_started: Used first to finish the voucher already started.
reason.fewest_sessions_left: Used first because it has the fewest sessions left.
reason.oldest_voucher: Used first because it was bought first.
reason.stable_order: Both vouchers are equivalent; this one always goes first.
reason.generic: This is the voucher that will be used.

sessionRefund.title: Voucher session
sessionRefund.expired: {name} expired on {date}. The session goes back to it anyway.
sessionRefund.done: {name}: the session is back on the voucher.
sessionRefund.loadFailed: The voucher sessions of this sale could not be read. Try again before finishing the return.
sessionRefund.refundFailed: That voucher session could not be given back.

reason.already_refunded: This session was already given back on another return.
reason.not_settled: This session was never paid, so there is nothing to give back.
reason.generic: This session cannot be given back.

ui.movementsHint: every session of this voucher: reserved, delivered, released, expired and given back.
ui.movementRefundedExpired: The session went back to a voucher that had already expired: it is on the books, but it cannot be spent until the voucher is valid again.
ui.emptyMovements: This voucher has not been used yet.
ui.orphansHint: Their customer sheet was deleted or anonymised. The voucher keeps everything it was sold with — refund it or move it to another sheet.
ui.emptyOrphans: No voucher has lost its customer.
ui.errorOrphans: The vouchers with no customer could not be loaded.

errors.services.category_unavailable: That category is not available: it does not exist in this business or it has been deleted.
errors.services.service_update_rejected: The service could not be updated: it does not exist in this business, or the category you picked does not.
errors.services.service_not_found: That service does not exist in this business.
errors.services.service_not_archived: That service could not be brought back: it does not exist in this business, or it is already being offered.
errors.services.parent_category_unavailable: That parent category is not available: it does not exist in this business or it has been deleted.
errors.services.category_update_rejected: The category could not be updated: it does not exist in this business, or the parent you picked does not (or is the category itself).
errors.services.category_not_found: That category does not exist in this business.
errors.services.package_not_found: That package does not exist in this business.
errors.services.package_no_grant: This customer does not have that voucher: nobody has sold it to them.
errors.services.grant_customer_required: Pick the customer this voucher belongs to: a voucher with no owner cannot be redeemed.
errors.services.package_needs_lines: A package needs at least one service line: a package with no lines cannot be sold or redeemed.
errors.services.package_no_uses_left: This voucher has no sessions left.
errors.services.package_not_redeemable: This voucher cannot be redeemed right now.
errors.services.package_does_not_cover_service: This voucher does not cover that service. A voucher of haircuts pays for haircuts, not for the shampoo.
errors.services.hold_not_releasable: That voucher session can no longer be given back: the sale was already paid. Refunding it is a return, and it goes through its own door.
errors.services.hold_not_settleable: That voucher session could not be settled: it does not exist here, it was already given back, or it was settled before.
errors.services.redemption_not_found: That voucher session does not exist in this business.
errors.services.redemption_not_settled: That voucher session was never paid, so there is nothing to give back. Release the hold instead.
errors.services.redemption_already_refunded: That voucher session was already given back on another return.
errors.services.redemption_not_refundable: That voucher session cannot be given back right now.
